verification.title: Peer review capacity
verification.question: How many studies can reviewers check?
verification.watch: Watch the review queue and publications. An empty queue does not establish reliability.

generation.title: Idea generation
generation.question: What happens when ideas arrive faster?
generation.watch: Compare the review queue with the number of studies tested.

replication.title: Independent repeats
replication.question: What changes when more findings can be tested again?
replication.watch: Watch repeat tests, failed repeats and withdrawals together.

funding.title: Research funding
funding.question: Does more funding remove the bottleneck?
funding.watch: Compare active studies and publications; another stage may limit throughput.

aiAdoption.title: AI-assisted generation
aiAdoption.question: Can faster idea production outpace checking?
aiAdoption.watch: Compare generated ideas, review queues and model-known false claims.

sampleSize.title: Sample size
sampleSize.question: What does a larger sample change?
sampleSize.watch: Follow tested studies and false claims; resource costs can also change.

alpha.title: Statistical threshold
alpha.question: What happens when a positive result becomes easier to declare?
alpha.watch: Compare publications with model-known false claims.

transparency.title: Open methods
transparency.question: Can a predeclared analysis reduce selective reporting?
transparency.watch: Compare false claims and publication counts, keeping the other settings equal.

pressure.title: Publication pressure
pressure.question: What if positive results receive more reward?
pressure.watch: Compare output and false claims; more papers is not necessarily better knowledge.

diversity.title: Search across communities
diversity.question: What happens when teams explore outside their own community?
diversity.watch: Watch cross-community studies and live claims. There is no built-in proven quality bonus.

network.title: Knowledge diffusion
network.question: Does more attention bring more checking?
network.watch: Compare citations and independent repeats. Attention is not evidence of truth.

uncertainty.title: AI caution
uncertainty.question: What changes when uncertain agents hold back?
uncertainty.watch: Compare ideas, tested studies and false claims; useful ideas may also be missed.
